summary: Adds an optional Longest-Match Label Mapping procedure to the Label Distribution Protocol so label switched paths can span multiple IGP areas within one autonomous system. A label may be used when the forwarding equivalence class matches an entry in the routing table, rather than needing an exact match, which lets routes summarized between areas still work for label switching.

eli5.summary: Normally you need the exact street address to deliver a package. This lets routers accept a close-enough match, such as just the town, so deliveries can cross borders between neighborhoods of a big network.
